tacticalDefeat.consequences: Hero survives with 1 HP; lost units removed from army stack.
tacticalDefeat.recoveryRoute: Rest in town restores mana; recruit replacement stack at Barracks using passive producer gold; re-enter encounter.

defenseDefeat.consequences: Core breaches and defense resolves DEFEATED; 0 gold gained; surviving towers retain rank.
defenseDefeat.recoveryRoute: Clean re-entry into fresh defense session; reposition hero/army on pads; adjust tower placement.

softlockSafeguards: Town Hall produces continuous baseline resources even with 0 external producers.
Rest action costs 0 gold/food and restores 100% hero mana.
Market quotes guaranteed baseline exchange rates for excess wood/stone to gold.
Practice Skirmish and Challenge allow free skill and tactical rehearsal without casualty risk.
